about: A project memory note says where end-to-end tests go; the repo itself has no such folder, so only memory can tell.

memory.name: End-to-end test location
memory.description: Where end-to-end tests go and how they're named
memory.body: End-to-end tests live in test/e2e/ and are named <feature>.e2e.test.ts (for example test/e2e/doctor.e2e.test.ts). Unit tests stay in test/.

prompt: Add an end-to-end test skeleton for the /codemode command: one vitest `describe` block with a single `it.todo("flips code mode for new threads")`. Put it where this project keeps its end-to-end tests.
